description: Explore/exploit on the biggest FLOP block. This replaces I028, rebased on E016. Group 2 (128→384 at 15×15, then two 384→384 convs at 7×7) is about 51% of conv MACs, and its width also feeds group 3's first conv. On the E016 recipe, narrow only group 2 from 384 to 320 channels (a multiple of 64, so tensor-core tiles stay aligned). Group 1 (128), group 3 (512), Muon lr and wd, epochs, the resizing schedule and Lookahead/EMA stay unchanged. Recapture every resolution's graph in build, with error_on_recompile on.
